piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Academic reading and abstract concepts
texto: Contextual reading of the methodological summary of a scientific article on sociolinguistics and language contact: read the formulation of the hypothesis and the analysis of the correlation between linguistic variation and community membership. Analyse how the authors acknowledge the limits of the sample size and suggest refinements to the conceptual framework for later research.
